name: 5 Layer Shelve Rack Corner Table Display Furniture Decorative Foldable Shelf Finish DIY
description:
Design of melamine board shelf and pipes may vary

DIY assembly (instructions included in the box)

Ideal for living room and bedroom

Perfect for storing and displaying CDs, DVDs, books, toys, and decorative items

Adds style and functionality to any corner of your room

Product Dimensions: Length 35 cm × Width 48 cm × Height 122 cm

Color: As shown in the picture

Description:
Enhance your living space with this versatile corner shelf made of melamine boards and sturdy pipe frames. Easy to assemble with included instructions, it provides stylish storage and display for your books, CDs, toys, and other items. Its compact design fits perfectly in corners, adding both organization and a touch of elegance to your living room or bedroom.
